items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: But Martinez supervised the playing of the music. If the parts didn't sound right, he'd come down and look them over and tell you what note he wanted playing.

ctx.x: Did Martinez stand up and conduct the band with the guitar? Or how did he do it?

Well, Martinez was more of a supervisor of the band. Louis DeMaine was the director. He actually directed the band. He actually directed the band. But Martinez supervised the playing of the music. If the parts didn't sound right, he'd come down and look them over and tell you what note he wanted playing. Because he was a professional piano player himself.
Did Louis DeMaine ever play his trumpet?
